title: Commerce protocol id
$comment: The closed set of commerce protocols an LCP reference can be carried through. CLOSED, not open: an open string type lets a typo mint a protocol, and the compatibility registry has nothing to iterate over. Members are ordered settlement-first, then placements, matching the registry's protocol taxonomy. NOT a member: `escrow` (a settlement MECHANISM that several protocols settle through) and any scheme id such as `evm:x402` (that is BindingManifest.rail, a different field with a different job). The binding profile and placement manifest schemas INLINE these same values (as the halt-class schema's consumers do) so each validates standalone under the inline-schema subject protocol; package tests guard every copy against this file.
